title: Premium Tariff Schedule for Pass and Trip Protection
content:
Premium under Pass and Trip Protection is rated plan by plan. The table below is the tariff the protection
side of the collective holds for the six plans, and it states, for each of them, the basis the premium is
rated on, the flat amount where the plan is rated flat, the rate taken of the covered value where it is
rated on value, the smallest and largest premium the plan is written for whatever the covered value, the way
the premium is collected, and the number of calendar days an instalment of premium may go unpaid before
cover stops.

| Plan | Premium basis | Flat premium (USD) | Rate of covered value | Smallest premium (USD) | Largest premium (USD) | Collection | Grace period (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season Pass Protection Basic | Flat premium | 39.00 | 0.00 per cent | 39.00 | 39.00 | Single payment | 10 |
| Season Pass Protection Plus | Percentage of covered value | 0.00 | 6.50 per cent | 49.00 | 195.00 | Alongside the covered holding's instalments | 14 |
| Season Pass Protection Premier | Percentage of covered value | 0.00 | 8.50 per cent | 79.00 | 349.00 | Alongside the covered holding's instalments | 21 |
| Collective Trip Protection Standard | Percentage of covered value | 0.00 | 7.00 per cent | 59.00 | 495.00 | Single payment | 10 |
| Collective Trip Protection Elite | Percentage of covered value | 0.00 | 9.00 per cent | 119.00 | 995.00 | Alongside the covered holding's instalments | 21 |
| Collective Total Protection Concierge | Percentage of covered value | 0.00 | 11.50 per cent | 349.00 | 3500.00 | Alongside the covered holding's instalments | 30 |

**Note on the rated plans.** Only Season Pass Protection Basic is rated flat; it carries no rate of value, and
its smallest and largest premium are the same 39.00 USD, so its premium does not move with the value covered.
The five plans rated on value carry no flat amount at all, and the smallest and largest premium of each are
the floor and ceiling the plan is written between.

**Note on collection.** Season Pass Protection Basic and Collective Trip Protection Standard are collected in
a single payment; Season Pass Protection Plus, Season Pass Protection Premier, Collective Trip Protection
Elite and the Collective Total Protection Concierge plan are collected alongside the covered holding's
instalments. The grace period runs from 10 calendar days on the two plans collected in a single payment and
on nothing else, through 14 days on Season Pass Protection Plus and 21 days on Season Pass Protection Premier
and Collective Trip Protection Elite, to 30 days on the Collective Total Protection Concierge plan.
